correctness.rationale: The upper bound is an explicit 21-word code generated from seven representatives by the three cyclic alphabet translations; a fresh independent replay found 21 distinct codewords and all 81 ternary length-four targets in their distinct one-deletion shadows. For the lower bound, the ten symmetry-orbit weights have total numerator 468 over denominator 23, and an independent exhaustive pass over all 243 length-five centers found every deletion-ball numerator at most 23. Thus any cover has size at least ceil(468/23)=21. The proof is finite and exact, with no floating-point or timeout inference.
risks: The theorem is only q=3,n=5,R=1 and does not classify optimal covers.
